{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && cat > specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md <<'CK_EOF'
# Specification Quality Checklist: Atomic Batch Transactions for TinyDB (milestone 2)

**Purpose**: Validate specification completeness and quality before proceeding to planning
**Created**: 2026-10-17 (updated for milestone 2 + Claim-A extensions)
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

## Content Quality

- [x] No implementation details (languages, frameworks, APIs)
- [x] Focused on user value and business needs
- [x] Written for non-technical stakeholders
- [x] All mandatory sections completed

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] No [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers remain
- [x] Requirements are testable and unambiguous (R04/R05/R05b/R06 boundaries each have an acceptance scenario)
- [x] Success criteria are measurable (SC-001..SC-008)
- [x] Success criteria are technology-agnostic (no implementation details)
- [x] All acceptance scenarios are defined (US1-US5)
- [x] Edge cases are identified (malformed ops, bool IDs, unsupported fields, non-list input, empty document, preview purity, failed-apply sequencing, interleaved direct inserts, missing target, empty batch, nested data, pre-existing handles)
- [x] Scope is clearly bounded (default table only; additive; no cross-table transactions)
- [x] Dependencies and assumptions identified (Assumptions section; no external dependencies)

## Feature Readiness

- [x] All functional requirements have clear acceptance criteria (FR-001..FR-009, FR-004a/b/c)
- [x] User scenarios cover primary flows (apply, atomic rollback, transparency/no-aliasing, preview purity, ID sequencing under mixed use)
- [x] Feature meets measurable outcomes defined in Success Criteria
- [x] No implementation details leak into specification

## Notes

- Updated 2026-10-17 to incorporate milestone 2 (R04/R05/R06), Claim-A extension R05b (detached preview list), and the round-2 R05 clarification (wrapper advances and persists next-insertion-ID state on successful batches; no reuse/rewind even across removes; failed apply consumes no IDs).
- Conflicting evidence packet recorded and resolved in spec.md "Conflicting Evidence - Resolved": the older note ("preview may consume IDs and bool IDs are accepted") is unverified and superseded by R04/R05.
- Items marked incomplete would require spec updates before $speckit-clarify or $speckit-plan; none remain.
CK_EOF
echo CHECKLIST_UPDATED; grep -c "\[x\]" specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md; grep -c "NEEDS CLARIFICATION" specs/001-transactions/spec.md"}
